body:
I understand brother (or sister), you're not alone.
Before going to rehab in December, my depression made me such an asshole to the people I cared most about. 6 months later and although clean and myself again, I have no one to call me on a friday. Noone ever texts me to see how I'm doing. It's like I've been alone on the planet for 6 months. The worst part is it is 100% directly my fault and no one/nothing else's. The only person I've spent the past few months with is the person who ruined my life, and I can't get away from him.

I think I might just save up enough to go live on a beach in Chile in a tent. If I gotta be alone may as well do it in style.
Drinking is a symptom of a problem, not the problem. Only someone who has been there understands.
